request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the big striped ball on his shoulder: it becomes a smaller, flatter rusted iron shoulder pad with a dark rim and two bolts, still painted with hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes; add two lighter brown stitched hide patches on the black tunic. Do not touch his head, skin or ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: bandana, bandage wraps, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
